audit_doctrine_and_training.doctrine_summary: Audits sentence structure variety, paragraph lengths, and rhythm to eliminate monotonous repetition.
audit_doctrine_and_training.review_methodology: Statistical analysis of sentence lengths, dialogue-to-action ratios, and atmospheric staging.
drift_detection_heuristics: Ensure balance between character dialogue, practical logistics, and quiet observation
Avoid repetitive clause structures and identical paragraph openers

drift_detection_patterns.failure_signature: Repeating identical phrases in consecutive paragraphs

findings: Prose cadence flows naturally with appropriate dramatic weight and atmospheric depth.
